raw.thesis:
Narma is creating an "Enterprise Agentic Brain" for AI-first companies. The core innovation lies in its ability to observe work patterns through desktop sensors, understand employee intent and business value via an "Intelligence Layer," and then automatically generate, deploy, and monitor AI agents through an "Agent Factory." This allows companies to identify high-ROI opportunities for AI automation and achieve "Continuous AI lift."

Narma is designed for AI-first companies that are looking to scale their AI automation efforts. These companies likely struggle with understanding where AI can be most effectively applied within their existing workflows, proving the value of such applications, and then seamlessly deploying and managing AI agents. Narma addresses the problem of inefficient resource allocation and missed opportunities for AI intervention by providing a system that can "see, prove, and deploy AI automation at scale."

The founder's goal appears to be building a growth startup, aiming to capitalize on the increasing adoption of AI in enterprise settings. The venture is currently at the idea stage, as evidenced by the description of its conceptual architecture and functionality without mention of a built product or users.

Narma positions itself as a foundational layer that complements existing foundation models. Instead of building its own LLMs, it leverages them to focus on the "Work Graph" – understanding how work is actually done within an organization. This means Narma isn't replacing existing AI solutions but rather providing an intelligence and deployment layer on top of them, enabling better utilization and targeting of AI within an enterprise.
things_that_must_work: Accurate detection of employee intent and business value from desktop sensor data
Automated generation and reliable deployment of AI agents
Effective monitoring and approval gates for AI agent deployment
raw.product_description: Narma is an "Enterprise Agentic Brain" with a three-layer architecture. Layer 1 (Observe) uses lightweight desktop sensors to capture work patterns, application usage, activity sequences, and time allocation. Layer 2 (Intelligence Layer) acts as a "Brain" to detect employee intent, business value, and "drift" in workflows. Layer 3 (Execution Layer) is an "Agent Factory" that generates, deploys, and monitors AI agents for validated high-ROI opportunities, with built-in approval gates. Narma leverages existing foundation models and focuses on understanding the "Work Graph" to identify where AI can assist work mid-flow.
raw.core_excitement: The founder is excited about enabling AI-first companies to achieve "Continuous AI lift" by precisely understanding and automating their work processes.
raw.what_makes_this_different: Narma's specific innovation is its focus on the "Work Graph" to reveal where resources are being consumed inefficiently and where AI can be injected into workflows to provide assistance, rather than attempting to build new foundation models. It offers a structured approach to observing, intellectualizing, and executing AI automation at scale.
